abstract: We find the correct order of magnitude for the number of $n\leq x$ having at least $r$ divisors in the interval $(y,2y]$, uniformly in a wide range of the parameters $x,y,r$.
hook: Integers with many divisors in a short range are now counted to the correct order of magnitude.
hook_turn: to the correct order of magnitude.
summary: The authors find the right order of magnitude for how many integers up to x have at least r divisors between y and 2y. The result holds across a wide range of x, y and r. It is an order-of-magnitude bound, not an exact asymptotic.
title: Integers with many divisors in a dyadic interval
